findings.issue: Double-quoted settings discard backslashes in unknown escape sequences. A Windows credential path such as C:\Users\Alice\Secrets\youtube-credentials.json becomes a different, relative path; passphrases containing literal backslashes are also changed. Preserve unknown escapes.

Splitting before parsing quotes truncates multiline quoted passphrases and can interpret assignment-looking lines inside the secret as separate environment settings. Parse a complete quoted value before advancing to the next assignment.

Only a space followed by # is treated as an unquoted comment, and trimming first turns KEY= # comment into a nonempty credential. Comment-only values and comments without a preceding space or with a tab must be excluded while quoted hashes remain literal.

A blank GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID or GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET loaded from .env is incorrectly reported as an empty shell override. Use loadEnvFile's imported-key metadata to identify the actual source and tell the user to edit the loaded file.

summary: Fixed four .env onboarding defects: lost literal backslashes, truncated multiline secrets, comments parsed as credential values, and blank file settings misreported as shell overrides. All four new regression tests failed before the fixes; npm test now passes 27/27 and the MCP smoke test passes 1/1. MCP verification also checks the configured credential path, JSON framing, and secret absence on stdout and stderr.
